attribution_assessment.safe_future_wording: Anadolu reported on November 3 that UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said only half of humanitarian partners' waste-collection vehicle fleet in Gaza was operational because of Israeli restrictions on engine oil and spare parts. He warned that incomplete rubbish collection was increasing public-health risks and called for wider entry of essential supplies. This records the UN's assessment of ongoing conditions; the underlying assessment period was not specified.
